dataList.dlg: 'Twas my spear that skewered the foe's throat last! Surely that kill is mine to claim? That leaves thee with two, young Sinclair. Fair's fair. What kind of logic is that? We both ran that one through—so that's two and a half each. Seriously, how do you say that with a straight face?

<color=#ffef23>Young Sinclair!! Come thee to the cupboard...! Prithee, fetch down the cereal...! Who saw fit to place it at such a lofty height?!</color>
... I did. When I used to be able to reach it. Now I can't.
<color=#ffef23>W-well, that's...</color>
You know, if you'd actually bothered to read the fine print on the insurance, I wouldn't have been stuck like this...

"Tangsuyuk". "Yukgaejang"! "Jambon-beurre". Re... "Reblochon on potato gratin"! Ugh... Tang... "Tangbao"...? O... "Omurice"! What sayest thou to that? Heh. "Smørrebrød". Ehhhh?! "Ble"? "Bro"? What manner of food is that?! It's an open-faced sandwich. All right, then. Guess you're buying lunch today. *groan* Very well. I shall fetch some omurice... to go.

<color=#ffef23>Nnngh...! *huff* *huff* Every evening... 'tis the same nightmare—those wretches tearing young Sinclair limb from limb, again and again...</color>
...? Did you call me?
<color=#ffef23>Ah, n-nay! 'Tis nothing, nothing at all!</color>

... Don Quixote, please tell me you haven't forgotten the upcoming insurance renewal.
<color=#ffef23>Hm?! N-nay, of course not...!</color>
... And go over the add-ons. I swear, if you forget to get the clone body's growth shots covered again, I'm gonna... *sigh*
<color=#ffef23>'Twas my fault, forsooth... Have I not admitted my guilt often enough...?</color>

Ugh... You know, you're getting insufferable. Nobody said you were wrong or anything. Verily, we ought to give him some space, young Sinclair... He hath yet to recover... No, enough is enough. All we said was we'll work together on this one job 'cause Fixers who think like you aren't a good fit for our Office, simple as that. And you had to be a miserable ass about it out of the blue! Could you please... never mind. Look, you little—stop frowning already, would you?

A wedge, thou seest, is a weapon most divorced from cleaving and crushing. Behold the pinpoint-keen tip of this spear mine: dost thou see?! 'Tis a weapon of unparalleled efficiency! A strike most singular and focus most fine requireth little strength to execute. Such is the work befitting a "Wedge!" Consequently! Those who seek our Office with a quest in their bosom expect no brute strength, nay; 'tis swiftness and precision... founded upon the bedrock of shrewd and precise situational assessment! Heh heh, that is what our Office is!

Not exactly the kind of situation where we can afford to be polite. I'll get to skewering you right away.
<color=#ffef23>As a Fixer, I can scarce afford proper etiquette when lives stand at stake! Surely thou canst understand!</color>
Our Office has particularly low tolerance for dickheads who like to dress themselves up as "selfless." Doubly so when the most selfish of them don't seem to realize that himself.

... How long is that punk going to leech on our Office?
<color=#ffef23>Prithee, practice patience! Thou recallest Lady Outis's reassurance, dost thou not? He shall depart anon following this contract's completion.</color>

Hey, don't glare at us now. We just poked you to make sure.
<color=#ffef23>Heh heh, I had heard that thou wert supposed to be "nice"—I expect naught else but the maximum generosity from thee!</color>
... Are you trying to pick a fight with me?
I'll skewer you all.
... Don Quixote told you to talk to me, didn't she? Tell her I don't have time for chit-chat either!
Skewer!
Let's make this quick.
Tsk, no help at all...
You guys always end up on a skewer, anyway.
What an... idiotic move...
... All in a day's work.
... Heard you the first time! C'mon, this has to be right...

<color=#ffef23>Phew... That be one quest behind us! What sayest thou, young Sinclair, to a moment's respite?</color>
We still have some headaches to deal with, but... Eh, it's whatever at this point, right?

They gave us some trouble, but—
<color=#ffef23>—verily, once accepted, no contract is beyond us!</color>
Yeah, this contract was also—
<color=#ffef23>—settled in the Wedgiest fashion!</color>
ARRRGH!!!!! Holy shit, can you stop cutting me off for one damn second?!

Damn punk... I knew he'd hightail it the moment shit hit the fan...
<color=#ffef23>Alas... 'twas an expected outcome, was it not...?</color>
Tsk, don't talk...! You're gonna lose more blood than insurance's willing to cover...
